node.statement: Dependency repair for the negative-mass line: the verifier is correct that delta(P)<=||P-Q||_{inf->inf} cannot be concluded from only def-stochastic and def-signed-idempotent. The missing allowed input is a definition of negative mass, namely delta(P)=max_i sum_j max{-P_ij,0}. Once that definition is registered, the rowwise proof is immediate: Q_ij>=0 implies max{-P_ij,0}<=|P_ij-Q_ij| for each i,j; summing in j and taking max_i gives delta(P)<=max_i sum_j |P_ij-Q_ij|=||P-Q||_{inf->inf}. Without this definition, the delta-bound part of the parent node remains unproved.
